specialist_capabilities.description: Build requirement-to-test acceptance evidence for AI training and support behavior without claiming buyer acceptance.
Define bounded contract tests and failure evidence for CBS, Inkobook, reporting, and channel adapters without live external access.
Verify retry, replay, and idempotency behavior for state-changing integration workflows.
Produce deterministic control and interaction evidence suitable for owner review.
Reconcile bounded migration or knowledge-ingest outputs with explicit exception ledgers.
Build language-specific acceptance cases and regression evidence without claiming native-language staffing.
Exercise escalation context preservation and handoff failure modes using synthetic fixtures.
